claims.content: C2 JU
A C² JU recognizes that two tracks which are being reported to the interface are eligible for correlation.

All C² JUs capable of reporting air or surface tracks shall have the capability to transmit and receive all the response values of the J7.2 message for real-time air and/or surface tracks, which are held locally by their system.
A C² JU recognizes that two tracks which are being reported to the interface are eligible for correlation.

trigger.raw_text: A C² JU recognizes that two tracks which are being reported to the interface are eligible for correlation.

claims.content: The recognizing JU shall transmit the J7.2 Correlation message requesting all other C² JUs to perform a correlation of the two tracks.
The message identifies the TN to be retained and the TN to be dropped.

The receiving JUs shall accept the requested correlation unless certain prespecified conditions exist which require or allow the receiving JU to reject the requested correlation or respond with a reverse correlation request.
The originating JU indicates in the J7.2 message if it has any constraints which would prohibit accepting a reverse correlation.

The receiving JU may reject the requested correlation if local/remote data held indicates any of the following conditions exist: (1) The two tracks have an Identity (ID) difference which constitutes a conflict; (2) The two tracks have different Mode I codes, and the local Mode II code is current; (3) Both tracks are locally derived real-time tracks, i.e., being updated with local positional data; (4) Either track has the Strength field set to a value greater than 1.

If the use of automatic restriction capability changes, all participating C² JUs will be informed through voice communication or other communications media. In lieu of specific interface direction, all JUs will restrict automatic correlation by default.

Systems shall have an initialization parameter and an operator selectable capability to inhibit automatic restriction. Use of this capability will be subject to interface coordination and must be promulgated to all C² JUs.
A C² JU shall not automatically correlate two tracks if local/remote data held indicates any of the listed conditions exist. These restrictions do not apply to manual correlation.
If the two tracks are of a different E/C, or either track has an existing E/C conflict, the correlation shall be rejected.
If one track is simulated and the other is live, the correlation shall be rejected.
If both tracks are locally derived real-time tracks, the correlation shall be rejected.
When a correlation request is rejected for a manual correlation, the JU originating the request shall provide an operator alert as a cue to conduct voice coordination.
An operator alert in the event of the rejection of an automatic correlation shall be a system option.
